title: “Monopoly man” told me I was pregnant
content: I go to “Mall world” or whatever tf it is every single night. I’m usually just walking around the mall, eating at the food court, shopping, lurking, doing weird stuff etc etc. The mall is usually pretty empty and a bit unsettling. Not scary, but definitely has “enter the void” vibes if anyone has seen that movie Anyway, I was walking to the food court when all of the sudden everyone I passed (I suddenly passed like, dozens of people) said “congrats on your girl!!” I said “thanks!” but then quickly realized that I was confused as to why they said that. My daughter was born 7 months ago, so they shouldn’t be congratulating me for something so long ago I got to the end of the line of people, and a man who looked like Mr. Monopoly said the same thing to me. I asked him “a second girl?” and he smiled and nodded at me. I woke up after that Fast forward a week or so later, turns out I’m pregnant again, and I’m pretty sure it will be a girl. First off, I’m so so so creeped out. I’m like… in tears writing this right now because it’s just so weird to me, especially the vibes of Monopoly Man. It was almost as if he could see my entire future or some shit, or as if he was like… the “God” of the mall or something??? He had white hair, a white long mustache, and wore a gray suit. Who is this dude??? has he appeared before in anyone else’s dream? Either way, I just wanted to share. I never ever interact with the people in my dreams (only my family members if they show up) so the fact that 15+ people told me congrats AND I ACTUALLY TURNED OUT PREGNANT is beyond insane to me
